title: Vowel Wraith
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: An alien formant lead in the mid-high register: a sawtooth voice morphs through cycling vowels with deep slow vibrato and a wandering stereo pan, while a band-pass sweep and FM grit roar underneath. Over 24 cycles the vowel set, vibrato depth, FM index and filter all drift on mutually prime clocks so the voice keeps shape-shifting before the loop repeats.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<f4 [f4 ab4] c5 <eb4 bb4>>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o u e>/3")
    .vib("<5 7 11>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(17).range(0.3, 2.2))
    .fm(sine.slow(13).range(1, 7)).fmh("<1 1.5 2>/4")
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(500, 4200)).resonance(16).ftype("ladder")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.12, 0.88))
    .shape(saw.slow(31).range(0.2, 0.5))
    .coarse("<1 1 2>/6")
    .sometimesBy(0.15, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.4))
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.18).sustain(0.6).release(0.12)
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.7).gain(0.8)
)
